meta.coverage: Financial-year average index and growth on a year earlier, as published: General, sectoral, use-based and 2-digit industries
meta.note: Discontinued base — superseded by 2022-23=100; plotted separately, never spliced (base-year rule). Financial years (April to March), dated at April of the first year. Levels and growth are MoSPI's own annual rows (frequency=Annually), not recomputed; the first year of a base has no growth.
